verdict.rationale: GitHub explicitly markets GitHub Actions with hosted runners ('Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD' [github-docs-11]), and users confirm they moved to GitHub after it matched GitLab's free CI/CD pricing [github-comm-19]. However, hands-on community reports describe frequent Actions outages tied to new releases affecting dev teams weekly [github-comm-18], broader platform reliability complaints [github-comm-1][github-comm-2][github-comm-4], and a historical gap in self-hosted runner support for orgs [github-comm-20], directly challenging the 'reliable, no-infra-management' claim.
